item.text:
**8B.1 Research Note**

Bottom line: **yes, clearly, but in a mixed and bifurcated way**. In 2024 Abiy Ahmed articulated a readable governing program in at least four lanes: macroeconomic reform, transitional justice, de-escalatory foreign policy, and sovereignty/security control. That makes later action evaluable. The record also shows a gap between reformist rhetoric and coercive practice, especially on emergency powers and information control.

**Accepted Claims**

- **Ethiopia Embarking on Full Implementation of Macroeconomic Reform Policy** | **ENA English** | **2024-07-28** | https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_4869646 | Abiy said Ethiopia had entered full implementation of macroeconomic reform to address debt burden, inflation, unemployment, and low productivity, and described prior reforms as a structured program rather than ad hoc crisis management. This is clear evidence of an articulated governing economic program. | **QIDs:** 8B.1, 7B.9, 7B.10

- **The Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia: Request of an Arrangement Under the Extended Credit Facility-Press Release; Staff Report; and Statement by the Executive Director for The Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia** | **International Monetary Fund** | **2024-07-29** | https://www.imf.org/en/publications/cr/issues/2024/07/29/the-federal-democratic-republic-of-ethiopia-request-of-an-arrangement-under-the-extended-552778 | The IMF described the authorities’ Homegrown Economic Reform Agenda as a comprehensive program to restore debt sustainability, lower inflation, move to a market-determined exchange rate, strengthen governance, and support private-sector-led growth. This is a detailed, evaluable policy program. | **QIDs:** 8B.1, 7B.9, 7B.10

- **Ethiopia to Pursue Transitional Justice Through Independent Justice Process** | **ENA English** | **2024-06-13** | https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_4596260 | The government said it was committed to a neutral, professional transitional-justice process with truth, reconciliation, amnesty, reparations, and institutional reform. That is explicit policy direction that can be checked against later implementation. | **QIDs:** 8B.1, 7B.6, 7B.7, 7B.10

- **Ethiopian Justice Minister Briefs Diplomats about Transitional Justice Policy Implementation** | **ENA English** | **2024-12-14** | https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_5626876 | The minister reiterated that the policy aimed at accountability, truth-seeking, conditional amnesty, reconciliation, and independent institutions, and said implementation roadmaps and legal frameworks were being prepared. This reinforces that Abiy’s government had a stated institutional roadmap, not just general rhetoric. | **QIDs:** 8B.1, 7B.6, 7B.7, 7B.10

- **Ethiopias leader plays down fears of conflict with Somalia over a planned naval port** | **Associated Press via CityNews** | **2024-02-06** | https://kitchener.citynews.ca/2024/02/06/ethiopias-leader-plays-down-fears-of-conflict-with-somalia-over-a-planned-naval-port/ | Abiy publicly said he had no intention of going to war with Somalia and framed peace as mutually beneficial. This is a specific, evaluable foreign-policy commitment rather than vague reassurance. | **QIDs:** 8B.1, 7B.8, 7B.10

- **Details of State of Emergency Declared by Gov't of Ethiopia** | **ENA English** | **2024-11-03** | https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/en_30124 | The proclamation said emergency rule was necessary to avert threats against national existence and sovereignty, placed enforcement under a State of Emergency Operation Command responsible to the prime minister, and suspended ordinary judicial authority over enforcement. This is explicit regime-control doctrine, not just security administration. | **QIDs:** 8B.1, 7B.7, 7B.9, 7B.10

- **In Ethiopia, a secret committee orders killings and arrests to crush rebels** | **Ethiopian Human Rights Commission / Reuters** | **2024-02-27** | https://ehrc.org/in-ethiopia-a-secret-committee-orders-killings-and-arrests-to-crush-rebels-reuters/ | The EHRC head confirmed the existence of the secret Koree Nageenyaa committee and said it interfered in the justice system with widespread human-rights violations. This reveals a covert coercive strategy beneath the public reform program. | **QIDs:** 8B.1, 7B.6, 7B.7, 7B.9, 7B.10

- **Ethiopia: Freedom on the Net 2024** | **Freedom House** | **2024** | https://freedomhouse.org/country/ethiopia/freedom-net/2024 | Freedom House reported mobile-internet restrictions, social-media restrictions, and journalist detentions under emergency powers. That is evidence that the government’s strategic direction included information control, which is part of its revealed governing program. | **QIDs:** 8B.1, 7B.6, 7B.7, 7B.9, 7B.10

- **Landlocked Ethiopia signs pact to use Somaliland’s Red Sea port** | **Reuters** | **2024-01-01** | https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Landlocked-Ethiopia-signs-pact-to-use-Somaliland-s-Red-Sea-port-45654814/ | The Berbera MOU tied port access to possible naval use, recognition, and stakes in state-run companies. That shows a revealed geopolitical strategy of leverage-seeking bargaining, not just abstract diplomacy. | **QIDs:** 8B.1, 7B.8, 7B.9, 7B.10

**Search Gap**

- I did **not** find a single 2024 manifesto or party platform that cleanly unified all of these strands into one doctrine.
- Instead, the governing direction is assembled from repeated statements and actions: **economic stabilization, transitional justice, peace/de-escalation, and coercive sovereignty control**.
- That fragmentation matters: the ideology is clear enough to evaluate, but it is not coherent in the sense of being internally consistent.
